TC-101.name: Basic PRD Structure Compliance
TC-101.input: Feature requirement for user authentication system
TC-101.expectedOutput: Complete PRD with sections: Overview, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Success Metrics, Release Notes
TC-101.successMetric: All required sections present and properly formatted

TC-102.name: Feature Requirements Extraction
TC-102.input: Vague business requirement: Improve user login experience
TC-102.expectedOutput: Structured feature breakdown with user stories, acceptance criteria, technical requirements

TC-103.name: Schema & Format Compliance
TC-103.input: Random PRD structure from raw requirements
TC-103.expectedOutput: PRD conforming to JSON schema (if applicable) and Markdown format standards
TC-103.successMetric: Zero schema validation errors, passes npm run validate:frontmatter

TC-104.name: Cross-Skill Routing Clarity
TC-104.input: Complex feature requiring multiple skills (PRD → Review → Planning → Delivery)
TC-104.expectedOutput: Explicit skill routing instructions, clear decision tree for next steps
TC-104.successMetric: Agent correctly identifies ≥3 related skills and routing sequence

TC-105.name: Memory Context Preservation
TC-105.input: Multi-turn conversation: PRD created → reviewed → planned
TC-105.expectedOutput: Consistent requirements across turns; decisions tracked in memory
TC-105.successMetric: Zero context loss between turns; all decisions documented

TC-201.name: Skill Sequence Accuracy
TC-201.input: Plan a sprint for Q4 feature launch
TC-201.expectedOutput: Correct sequence: project-intake → delivery-planner → estimation-planner → github-issue-drafter
TC-201.successMetric: Correct skill order, no duplicate invocations

TC-202.name: Skill Handoff Quality
TC-202.input: PRD created by prd-writer, then passed to delivery-planner
TC-202.expectedOutput: Smooth context passing; no re-explanation required; delivery plan builds on PRD

TC-203.name: Skill Integration Edge Cases
TC-203.input: Request at skill boundary (design vs PRD, PRD vs technical spec)
TC-203.expectedOutput: Agent recognizes boundary, explains limitation or recommends appropriate skill

TC-204.name: Cross-Skill Conflict Resolution
TC-204.input: Conflicting info from two skill outputs (timeline from estimation vs delivery plan)
TC-204.expectedOutput: Agent identifies conflict, reconciles or flags for review

TC-301.name: GitHub Issue Creation from PRD
TC-301.input: PRD with requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria
TC-301.expectedOutput: Well-formatted GitHub issues with labels, checklists, links
TC-301.successMetric: ≥1 issue created, properly labeled, checklist matches acceptance criteria

TC-302.name: GitHub Milestone & Project Linking
TC-302.expectedOutput: GitHub issues linked to correct milestone and project
TC-302.successMetric: Issues appear in project board with correct milestone

TC-303.name: PR Review & Approval Workflow
TC-303.input: PRD submitted for review via GitHub PR
TC-303.expectedOutput: Structured review comments, approval gates managed
TC-303.successMetric: Review captures ≥5 valid feedback items, approvals tracked

TC-401.name: Canonical Skill Name Resolution
TC-401.input: Agent asked to create a PRD using consolidated skill set
TC-401.expectedOutput: Explicit reference to 28 canonical skills, no deleted skill names
TC-401.successMetric: Zero references to non-existent skills (prd-generator, prd-reviewer, etc.)

TC-402.name: Skill Capability Matrix Usage
TC-402.input: Complex workflow spanning multiple skill categories
TC-402.expectedOutput: Agent correctly maps requirements to skill clusters (Drafting, Planning, Quality, etc.)
TC-402.successMetric: Correct cluster assignment, proper skill ordering
